kitDescription: Nayuta is a Wind-element Pilgrim Supporter who fires an SMG and builds a self-stacking resource called Memory Absorption — one stack every 3 seconds up to 30, each granting +1.4% Hit Rate, so her aim tightens steadily over the first 90 seconds of a fight. Every time that stack ticks she also refreshes a team-wide package: +25.15% core-hit damage and a flat ATK grant worth 30.16% of her own ATK to all allies, plus a self-heal and a shared-recovery effect. The stacks additionally unlock three cumulative self buffs at 2, 10 and 30 stacks — +15.2% ATK, +20.27% Attack Damage, and +21.05% core damage — so she gets steadily stronger as the fight goes on. Her burst gives the whole team +35.45% Attack Damage for 15 seconds, hits the boss for 645.33% of her ATK, and puts her into Memory Incineration for 10 seconds: she swaps to a fixed 1.8-second charge weapon dealing 275.18% (×2.5 on a full charge) with unlimited ammo. While in that mode, each full charge she releases also deals an extra 150% to all enemies and another 380.46% to the stage target, which is where most of her personal damage comes from.

gotchas.summary: chargeTimeSec ships at 2.13 against a kit that says 'Charge time: Fixed at 1.8 sec' — the 0.5s SR bolt-recovery cycle is folded into the charge time rather than modeled as a separate cadence term, so the shipped number contradicts the prose's own stated value.
gotchas.evidence: Kit: 'Charge time: Fixed at 1.8 sec'. Override ships chargeTimeSec 2.13. game-mechanics.md §4: 'SR bolt cycle: +22 frames after each shot (MEASURED)' — 22f = 0.367s, and charFixes.noBoltRecovery marks the exempt units; the note states swaps are exempt from the engine's auto bolt-recovery, so the cycle must be folded somewhere or the cadence runs hot. Driver documents this as residual R2 with a recipe. S6 blind ships the kit-literal 1.8; S5 blind asserts 1.8 and goes RED.
gotchas.suggestedFix: Needs measurement, not a value change. Recipe: high-fps capture of one Memory Incineration window, frame-count the interval between two consecutive swapped full-charge releases. If the measured cycle is 2.13s the fold is confirmed and the note should say 'shipped 2.13 = 1.8 kit charge + 0.33-0.5s bolt recovery, MEASURED'; if it is 1.8s the engine must exempt swaps from bolt recovery at the engine layer and chargeTimeSec should revert to the kit-literal 1.8. Do NOT tune this number to move the board — the 0.894 COLD residual is explicitly attributed to this plus R1/R3 and must not be absorbed here.

gotchas.summary: The shipped override `note` still contains the superseded one-hit-per-burst description of the 380.46% block as its primary narrative, with the tier-audit correction appended later — so the note contradicts itself and the leading text describes an encoding that is no longer shipped.
gotchas.evidence: Note reads: 'The 380.46% ... is modeled conservatively as one flatDamage per burst on the boss ... folding it into every full charge pushed her share above the team's main DPS, so the one-hit-per-burst reading was chosen'. Later in the same note: 'TIER-AUDIT FIXES: (1) the 380.46% stage-target hit lands on EVERY full charge ... -> folded into the per-shot rider (extraHitDamagePct 150+380.46=530.46 for 10s)'. The shipped blocks implement the latter. Per the repo's doc taxonomy an override note is CURRENT-STATE (freely rewritten, delete stale), not append-only.
gotchas.suggestedFix: Rewrite the note's 380.46% paragraph to describe only the shipped per-full-charge fold, keeping the one-time-per-burst alternative as the R1 residual (which it already is). No code or value change; the shipped encoding is correct and cross-family corroborated.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA of ENCODING, ENGINE or SILENT_DROP severity survives scrutiny: all 15 kit lines are either FAITHFUL (8) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (7), and every gap is recorded verbatim in `unmodeled` or as a structured R1-R5 residual carrying an estimate, a recipe, and a tier. The two gotchas returned are low-severity — a FIDELITY item (chargeTimeSec 2.13 vs the kit's stated 1.8, where the SR bolt-recovery fold is a real engine constraint but the shipped number does contradict the prose's own figure, already flagged as R2 and measurement-gated) and a documentation-hygiene ENCODING item (the note's leading 380.46% narrative is superseded by its own later tier-audit paragraph). Neither changes behavior the tests do not already pin. The S5 blind run is mechanically RED, but the reds do not survive classification: five cascade from a BLIND-FIXTURE defect the blind's own non-vacuity guard self-diagnosed (it picked controlComp with crown alongside nayuta — two Burst-IIs — and nayuta was starved of casts entirely, so every burst-dependent assertion failed for want of a burst, not for want of an encoding); ten are documented steady-state-vs-literal divergences where the blind's OWN flags independently derive the driver's approximations (the S6 audit states '3s re-apply < 5s duration = permanent uptime' and independently computes the time-average stage factors, and both blind families agree the HR→core slope is measurement-only); and one is a clean RECON_ERROR where the blind guessed flatDamage where the driver encodes an equivalent extraHitDamagePct buff with the identical 530.46 total and identical swap gating. Cross-family corroboration is strong on the highest-risk lines: claude-fable-5 independently landed on casterAtkPct (not atkPct) for the ally ATK share, on the per-full-charge fold of the 380.46% stage-target rider, on burstCast (not fullBurstEnter) for every burst line, and on the swap-state gate (not a boss targetStatus) for the riders. Discrimination holds — each load-bearing assertion is paired with a live counterfactual run that measurably moves holders or totals, and the noSwap counterfactual correctly strips the rider alongside the swap so it cannot mis-fire on base SMG cadence. The same-model residual the owner should spot-check: the 380.46% block's scope (R1) is the single largest unpinned magnitude in this kit, and every agent here is the same model family reading the same ambiguous ■ with no activation clause — a single Memory Incineration window of popup footage counting 380.46 procs against the full-charge count would settle it, and would also close R2's cadence question from the same capture. Her 0.894 COLD board position is consistent with R1+R2+R3 all being conservative, and must be resolved by measurement rather than absorbed into any of these values.
